resources.string: AALyrics needs Notification Access to detect the music currently playing on this device and load synchronized lyrics.
Android keeps this access under system settings. AALyrics checks the real system state again when you return.
You can disable this access at any time in Android Settings.

AALyrics keeps a legacy Android Auto media fallback for compatibility. Because this build is installed outside Google Play, enable Android Auto Developer Mode and Unknown sources to use that fallback.
Open Version, then tap Version and permission info 10 times to enable Developer Mode.
Open Developer settings from the Android Auto menu.
Android Auto does not expose this setting to AALyrics, so it cannot be verified automatically.
This setup is only for the legacy sideloaded media fallback. The templated Car App Library path does not require Android Auto Unknown sources.
